title: No late-night drinking: QC bars, karaoke venues face midnight cutoff for ASEAN Summit
summary: MANILA — Bars, karaoke venues, spas and other establishments in Quezon City will be required to close by midnight for a week as the city tightens security measures for the 49th ASEAN Summit.
